description: This file defines the MiddlewareInterface interface in the Psr\Http\Server namespace. It specifies the contract for middleware components involved in processing HTTP server requests and responses, defining the process method that accepts a server request and request handler, returning a response.

classes.name: MiddlewareInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for middleware components that process HTTP server requests and responses.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an incoming server request, possibly delegating to a request handler, and returns a response.
